name: Vittorio Vanini
bio: Heir to the Vanini chocolatiers of Lugano, whose pasticceria still stands on the main square, and a privateer who took delivery of Alfa Romeo 1900 C SS Zagato chassis 01931 through the Sonvico dealership in Ticino early in 1955. He entered it in the Mille Miglia that May as number 451 with Ivo Badaracco alongside him and finished nineteenth overall in 12h 56m — one of only thirty-nine 1900 SSZs Zagato ever bodied.
